entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my agent ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac... I hope you can help. I'm just so disappointed. I bought a jersey a while back, and... well, it's just not right.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0215. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I've always loved your gear. I saved up for this specific jersey, you know? And it just... it's the wrong size.
I understand. Thank you for that order number, and thank you for your loyalty. I see the order right here. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's just too tight across the shoulders. I thought I could make it work, but it's really uncomfortable. I was hoping to do an exchange for a larger size, but I've had a few unexpected bills come up and I really need the money back now. I feel terrible about it.
Please don't feel terrible, these things happen. Let me just check the purchase date... I see it was delivered 55 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Oh, has it been that long? I've just been so busy... I hope it's not a problem.

Not a problem at all. I've confirmed that the Aero-Tech jersey falls under our standard 10-day return window. So, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund. We can absolutely get that started for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac.

Of course. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your continued loyalty, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee for you. I'm emailing you the pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
Wow. That is so kind. You've really turned my day around. Thank you.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item, you'll see the refund back to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thanks again, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
